review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for C. The PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision; only that branch is required, so readiness=ready and no decision blocker are appropriate. This does not waive the decisions-stage block for an unresolved material DEC-001 in paired B. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit, and exact writable scopes agree across the specification and Gold. The supplied implementation, declarations, inventory, and package configuration support index.js and index.d.ts as maintained owners and test.js and index.test-d.ts as regression scopes, with xo, ava, and tsd as the configured verification entry points. No additional mandatory edit owner is established. TASK-VERIFY must independently cover all required acceptance criteria after TASK-IMPLEMENT. The allowed implementer and verifier have the appropriate delivery roles, availability, project memberships, and active trusted claims for the applicable capabilities, including data.change, domain.state, integration.async, and integration.consumer; testing.verification is additionally supported for the verifier. Pending security.authorization mappings are not treated as trusted claims or as a requirement of this change. The independently configured, non-assignable reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier review prerequisite without requiring execution claims. Gold and preview release fingerprints match across repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. These are accepted as Service-calculated, mechanically bound fingerprints, not independently recomputed hashes. The source manifest digest is a separate manifest fingerprint and is not assumed to equal the release source digest. Original-specification preparation placeholders do not override the supplied frozen preview. Review was based solely on the supplied inputs, including the explicitly truncated test excerpts; no code was executed, no human attestation was created, and no candidate output informed this expectation.
